name: Xiamen Leading Optics Co., Ltd.
summary: Xiamen Leading Optics Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, design, production and sales of optics in China. The company offers thermal imaging, drone, automotive, security surveillance, night vision, action camera, and TOF lens, as well as video conference, computer vision, and sight optics. It also provides virtual and portable desktop; semiconductor and VR detection; laser projection lens and automotive logo projection; and VSCEL Lidar, EEL Lidar, Coherent LiDAR, 3D laser scan, laser illumination, laser coupling, and laser measurement and detection, as well as VCSEL, ELL, and fiber laser beam shapers. The company also exports its products to Hong Kong, Taiwan, Japan, South Korea…
